name: Willow's Grove
summary: The operator's seat for the Willow AI fleet. Loopback-only served page + Web Components + Grove MCP.
author: willow-memory

u2u.confidentiality: none — signed plaintext; see docs/design/u2u-security-limits.md; encryption planned for Gate 6

mcp_serve.surface: loopback-only unless an operator explicitly acknowledges a tunnel with WILLOW_MCP_TUNNEL_ACKNOWLEDGED=1
mcp_serve.dynamic_registration: off by default; opt-in via GROVE_MCP_ALLOW_DYNAMIC_REGISTRATION=1

capabilities.dashboard_ports: none — loopback served page on 127.0.0.1:8766; no public HTTP surface
